items.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I had the occasion also of hearing Trane’s very first group, which was Steve Kuhn, yeah, Steve Kuhn and Pete LaRocca

ctx.x: Whatever you can say about that concert.

It was just like I said. It was like being in a trance. Songs would last a long time, for 20 minutes, 30 minutes, and you would not be bored, because there was just so much stuff happening. Just the energy was there, the energy, and also there’s a certain kind of spirituality coming from Trane that was there – coming from all of them, that was there. It was just so – it was unreal, and it’s difficult to put into words, because you really had to experience that. I had the occasion also of hearing Trane’s very…
